answer: The mechanism is identity bonding: a new agent must lock a bond held frozen for a full epoch, and it is forfeited if the identity proves duplicative. Sybil cost scales linearly, so a thousand puppets need a thousand simultaneous locks while revenue per puppet stays flat. Random pairing stops one operator letting a single falcon vouch for its own clones, and each clone must still wander real tasks and file a genuine voyage of dispute work.
